title: Item:Tome of Enhancement (Racial)
wikitext:
{{TomeTOC}}

[[Tome]] of Enhancement grants extra [[Action Point]](s) that can be used in racial [[enhancements]] tree.

[[File:Tome of Enhancement (Racial +1).png|thumb|right|420px|Tome of Enhancement (Racial +1)]]

== Description ==

Entwined with the words of this thick book is a powerful magical effect that grants a permanent +1 inherent bonus to Racial Enhancement Points.

This effect will not stack with other [[inherent bonus]]es to this skill (like those from other tomes) but will replace them if greater.

When this tome is consumed, your enhancement points usage will be recalculated with racial enhancement points being applied first to any points spent in the racial tree. This will cause you to be refunded a single universal enhancement point if you've already spent at least your current balance of racial points in the racial tree.

== Sources ==
* Tomes of Enhancement are {{Bind|BtC|BoA}} and were introduced with [[Mists of Ravenloft]] expansion. The ultimate bundle grants a free +1 tome to each character.
* Since [[Update 41]], +1 racial enhancement tomes are available from [[Raid#End_game_raids|tier 3 end game raids]].
* Since [[Update 41 Patch 2 Release Notes|Update 41 Patch 2]], +1 AP tomes are available from the [[DDO Store]] for 1995 DP (BtA).
* Since [[Update 41 Patch 3 Release Notes|Update 41 Patch 3]], +2 AP tomes are available from the [[DDO Store]] for 2495 DP. 
** +1 to +2 upgrade tomes cost 500 DP.
* [[Update 68]]'s preorder for [[Magic of Myth Drannor]] added +3 AP tomes, with an ultimate bundle granting one to every character.
* Since [[Update 71 Patch 2 Release Notes|Update 71 Patch 2]], +3 AP tomes are available from the [[DDO Store]] for 2995 DP (BtA). 
** +2 to +3 upgrade tomes cost 500 DP.

== What tome have you consumed ==
[[File:Inherent racial action point on the feats tab.png|thumb|right]]
To see what racial enhancement tomes has your character consumed, check your [[Character Sheet]] > Feats tab > Special Feats > Inherent Racial Action Point.
